text:
james.w: Hi support — customer on prod sees streaming responses cut at ~30s even when they set client timeout to 180s. They use redwood-python v0.20. Repro: long generation that should stream many tokens.

sara.k: Any logs? Is this the same as the "streaming chunk" cutoff we've seen? Could be LB idle timeout.

james.w: They attached a simple repro with code:

```
from redwood import Client
c = Client(api_key=..., timeout=180)
resp = c.generate_stream(model='rw-large', prompt='long...')
for chunk in resp:
    print(chunk.text)
```

It was cut after ~30s; client didn't throw, stream just closed.

chris_m: Two likely suspects: 1) wrong unit/param (timeout in ms vs s), 2) intermediate proxy/load balancer idle timeout (ALB/GCP/Cloud Run default 30s). Also older SDKs had `timeout` that only applies to connect/read but not to streaming chunk keepalive.

devex-anna: Quick checks: - Which transport (httpx/requests)? - Any reverse proxy in front? - Do they set REDWOOD_TIMEOUT_MS env var? - Are they using sync vs async client?

james.w: They use httpx async in FastAPI behind ALB. No env var set. Pip freeze shows redwood==0.20.0. They didn't set any per-request timeout beyond Client(...).

sara.k: Ok. Two concrete repro steps for customer:
1) curl the streaming endpoint directly (bypass LB) to see if it stays open:
```
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \
  https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate?model=rw-large
```
2) set REDWOOD_STREAM_KEEPALIVE=10 (or client stream_keepalive_interval=10) so keepalive pings are sent during long idle token generation.

chris_m: Also have them enable debug logs (env REDWOOD_LOG_LEVEL=debug) to see `x-request-deadline` header and kernel timeouts. If ALB is killing idle connections, you'll see connection reset with no server-side timeout.

james.w: Support-bot created ticket #SUP-14567 and attached initial logs.

support-bot: Ticket SUP-14567 created; owner: sara.k; priority: P2.

sara.k: Root cause after customer's ALB team checked: ALB default idle timeout 30s. Our SDK/hosted endpoints can be configured to send periodic chunk keepalives; older SDK versions didn't enable them by default. Workarounds:
- Upgrade to redwood>=0.24 where `stream_keepalive_interval` defaults to 10s, or
- Set `stream_keepalive_interval=10` in client config, or
- Increase ALB idle timeout to > generation time.

james.w: Sent workaround to customer and asked them to upgrade. Customer confirmed they bumped ALB to 120s and stream continues. Will plan to recommend SDK upgrade in release notes.

devex-anna: Adding a short snippet for docs and support KB:

```
# client config
c = Client(api_key=..., timeout={'connect':5,'read':60,'total':300}, stream_keepalive_interval=10)
# per-request override
c.generate(..., timeout=300)
```

sara.k: Closing thread after customer confirmed fixed. Will add KB entry referencing SUP-14567 and ALB keepalive guidance. :white_check_mark:
